name: Hozuki's Coolheadedness
description: Hōzuki is the aide to the great king of Hell, King Enma. Calm and super-sadistic, Hōzuki tries to resolve the various problems in Hell, including a rampaging Momotarō and his companions. However, he also likes spending his free time on his hobbies, such as fawning over cute animals and raising "Goldfish Flowers."

videos.title: The Enthusiasm Gap Between Fans and Non-Fans / The Foxy Yakan and Ooban Koban
videos.overview: It's time for a contest to find the new ambassador for Goldfish Flowers. How will one idol get herself dragged in? Hoozuki visits some hostess clubs and is daringly asked for assistance...

videos.title: Methods to Win the Zashiki Warashi / Idol Frontline
videos.overview: Hoozuki brings some Zashiki Warashi back with him from the mortal world and sends them to live with Hakutaku's. Hoozuki goes to see an idol show.

videos.title: Art is a Blast? / Art was a Blast
videos.overview: Hozuki and company visit a museum to see Nasubi's work and practice drawing together. Later, Nasubi and Hakutaku experiment with living art.

videos.title: The Blossom Front / Three Men, Three Personalities
videos.overview: Fourth OAD for Hozuki.

videos.title: Hell Handbook and the Dragon Palace / You'd Better Have a Go-to Song Ready
Episode 6
Episode 7
Making or Breaking Hell / The Discovery of Hell's Mysteries
videos.overview: While carrying out his hellish bureaucratic duties, Hozuki encounters a legendary hero. Hozuki and King Enma dream of taking a trip to Australia.

videos.title: Demons and Underwear and Crabs / The State of Hell, and This and That
videos.overview: Despite being tasked with cleaning the rivers of hell, low-ranking demon Nasubi becomes distracted by a song. King Enma welcomes a guest from Europe.

videos.title: Hakutakuk / How Their Discord Came to Be
videos.overview: Ignoring King Enma’s advice, Momotaro's companions risk visiting Hozuki on his day off. King Enma reveals why Hozuki and Hakutaku are always at odds.

videos.title: Pretty Boys Need Love Too / Kajika Hell
videos.overview: Accompanied by Shiro, Hozuki departs for the Karasu-Tengu police station. Hozuki teaches the lazy new demon recruits about the art of torture.

videos.title: The Instrumental Duo of the Mighty Rivals / Mental Sports Day
videos.overview: Hozuki and Shiro go on a quest for an essential stew ingredient. The 100th annual Hell’s Minions Sports Day commences with an unconventional bang.

videos.title: Hell Idol: Peach Maki / The Right Arm Blues
videos.overview: Looking for his next scoop, gossip magazine reporter Koban begs Hozuki for an interview. Beelzebub from European hell visits the Japanese underworld.

videos.title: Man and Woman and Mortal Hell / Hell-Style Acupuncture and Moxibustion Techniques and How to Use the Johari Mirror
videos.overview: Hozuki, Karauri and Nasubi visit an area of hell reserved for a certain kind of sinner. King Enma employs the help of Hozuki to receive acupuncture.

videos.title: The Vulgar Battle / The 36 Views of Hell
videos.overview: Koban turns his attention to Peach Maki and Hozuki in crafting his latest gossip article. Hozuki asks Nasubi to create a new mural fit for hell.

videos.title: The Ultimate Example of Ruin Through Wine and Women / Awash With Drunks
videos.overview: Momotaro makes an offhand comment that deals a blow to Hakutaku’s ego. Hozuki helps an eight-headed snake demon deal with a group of drunken sinners.

videos.title: Dinner of the Ten Kings of the Afterlife / Diets are Hell
videos.overview: King Enma holds a dinner for hell's nine other noble judges. Concerned about his weight, King Enma hits the gym with hell’s strictest trainer: Hozuki.

videos.title: The Samurai Who Was Inch-High / Marsh Sisters on the Mountain
videos.overview: After hearing the tale of the “Inch-High Samurai,” Shiro wonders what became of its titular hero. A pint-sized spirit comes to Hozuki with a problem.

videos.title: Lady Lillith and her Husband / Why Monsters are so Widely-Spread Throughout the Mundane World of China
videos.overview: Western she-devil Lady Lilith visits the Japanese underworld on a shopping trip. Hakutaku recalls the time he drunkenly fell into the mortal world.

videos.title: Hell's Bon Festival of Lights / Idle Chat with the Great King Enma
videos.overview: Shiro and his pals Rurio and Kakisuke experience their first-ever festival in hell. King Enma and Hozuki kill time until their next batch of sinners.

videos.title: Ancient Underworld Overhaul / The Palace with the Malice
videos.overview: As Lord Enma passes judgement on the denizens of hell, Hozuki's past is revealed. Has he always been a demon?

videos.title: Hell Minion for a Day / The Line Between Workaholic and Artist
videos.overview: Hozuki takes Maki and Miki around as hell minions to capture special tortures never seen before on film!

videos.title: The Auspicious Alliance / Eccentric Cuckoo-land Creature
videos.overview: The Four Benevolent Beasts argue over a meal about who is older and how well they are aging. Meanwhile, Hozuki has some problems of his own down in Hell.

videos.title: The Legend of Mustard / Please Turnip for the Demon Parade
videos.overview: Koban the paparazzo gets an interview with Mustard. When Hozuki gets involved in the interview as well, Koban gets far more of a performance than he bargained for.

videos.title: Ono no Takamura / Great King Enma and Anecdotes
videos.overview: After continually being mistaken for the Great King Enma, King Shinko muses about how he should differ himself to avoid future confusion with the deceased.

videos.title: Princess Sakuya's Showtime / The Battle of Children's Limbo
videos.overview: We get a look at Young Hozuki and what he was like when he was younger. Later, Hozuki has to deal with some children who ended up in Hell.

videos.title: In Those Days You Were Always On Edge / Dr. Monkshood
videos.overview: The inventions and ideas of the Engineering Department are being discussed while Young Hozuki tries to make sense of it all.

videos.title: Hopping Vampire
videos.overview: Young Hozuki accidentally discovers the dead and meets quite a unique King with an extraordinary power.

videos.title: Snow Demon / The Offices of Boring
videos.overview: A showdown arises between the Cold Hells and the Hot Hells. Meanwhile, Hozuki unravels the path of how the deceased enter hell.

videos.title: Kagachi's Coolheadedness / Married to His Work
videos.overview: Hozuki is questioned about his humdrum, daily program in the normal world. Meanwhile, the Gods demonstrate their extraordinary matchmaking capabilities.

videos.title: Family / The Hounds of Hell
videos.overview: Hozuki, with great reluctance, agrees to take a vacation for the weekend. In the meantime, the dogs bicker as they try to distinguish themselves amongst each other.

videos.title: King Gokan's Chief of Staff / Hell's Hot Springs
videos.overview: Shiro discovers the mighty Scales of Karma and yearns to do one more thing that will make him an accomplished dog of hell.

videos.title: Master of Hell / Have a Drink and Get Some Rest
videos.overview: The arrival of a special guest brings an unceasing barrage of annoyances as Hozuki prepares for the end of year party.

videos.title: The Day-to-Day at the Offices of Enma / 1 Soup, 3 Dishes, 10 Meats
videos.overview: Hozuki conducts interviews while dealing with a fraud and all the newcomers.

videos.title: What is a Magical Girl? / Indulging in Western Clothing
videos.overview: Learning about witches and girls western clothing bring about a whole new set of annoyances for Hozuki.

videos.title: Dakini of the Welcoming Committee / Under the Sod
videos.overview: Dealing with flesh-eating demons is a lot easier than receiving a vaccination (only if you're Hozuki, of course).

videos.title: The Man Who Learned From Yokai / The Woman Who Makes Use of Yokai
videos.overview: Love is a complicated thing, especially when the police and eons of family feuding are involved. Leave it to Hozuki to talk about...employee benefits?

videos.title: Amanojaku / Go Home, Crane
videos.overview: A stranded crane presents a set of holy and annoying problems for Hozuki, who was only trying to be... nice?

videos.title: Slippery as a Catfish / Gon Gets to Work
videos.overview: Hozuki learns that self-deprecation and laziness isn’t just for the Mundane world but is still just as annoying. How… tragic.

videos.title: Games / Mechanical Chief of Staff
videos.overview: Shiro, Rurio and Kakisuke take some time off at the Arcade and run into some interesting people. Hozuki has to entertain some new guests, hooray?

videos.title: The Rabbit Called Mustard / Types
videos.overview: The tiny and hellishly mighty Mustard describes her typical day of writing in her diary, looking for a partner and torturing souls.

videos.title: Yakan Siblings / Shiro's Butt is in a Real Jam
videos.overview: Hozuki, the ever eccentric man, is invited to teach young children about Hell. What could possibly go awry?

videos.title: Fundamentally / Mixed Martial Arts Contest
videos.overview: After some intense training with Hozuki, Mustard is ready for battle (even if her opponents are less than awake)!

videos.title: The Stripping Hag and Clothes-hanging Geezer / Chef Miki
videos.overview: Hozuki teaches the hell minions about the old people that dwell at the Sanzu River bank and the monsters within, but it proves to be more of a headache than anticipated.

videos.title: Onki / Animals Don't Forget One's Kindness
videos.overview: Momotaro returns to the fabled Ogre Island in response to a recent incident. Later, Hozuki visits the court of King Shoko, where animals are called as material witnesses.

videos.title: Unrivaled at Poker / Is Hell Your Intended Destination?
videos.overview: Hozuki uses the apathetic nature of the Zashiki Warashi twins to wrangle a newcomer to Hell. Later, Hozuki settles a disagreement between different departments.
